sql:
SELECT 
    v.name_cn,
    v.draught AS design_draught,       -- 设计吃水深度
    c.ais_draught AS current_draught,       -- 当前吃水深度
    ABS(c.ais_draught - v.draught) AS draught_diff -- 吃水差异绝对值
FROM maritime.vessel_reference v
JOIN maritime.vessel_current_state c 
    ON v.mmsi = c.mmsi
WHERE 
    v.draught IS NOT NULL              -- 设计吃水必须有值
    AND c.draught IS NOT NULL          -- 当前吃水必须有值
    AND c.retire_year_month IS NULL    -- 确保当前航次数据有效（未退役）
ORDER BY ABS(c.draught - v.draught) DESC
LIMIT 3;

query: IMO为9000015的船舶，上一个航段遇到的事件，列出事件海域，事件类型和事件描述
sql:
WITH previous_leg AS (
    SELECT
        vd.mmsi,
        vd.leg_start_postime,
        vd.leg_end_postime,
        fv.name_cn
    FROM maritime.vessel_state_history vd
    JOIN maritime.vessel_reference fv ON vd.mmsi = fv.mmsi
    WHERE fv.imo = '9000015'
      AND vd.dynamic_type = '5'      
      AND vd.is_new = 0
    ORDER BY vd.leg_start_postime DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ve.event_type_code,
    ve.event_location_cn,
    ve.event_desc_cn,
    ve.event_time,
    pl.leg_start_postime,
    pl.leg_end_postime,
    pl.name_cn
FROM maritime.vessel_event_log ve
JOIN previous_leg pl
  ON ve.mmsi = pl.mmsi                    
WHERE ve.event_time >= pl.leg_start_postime
  AND ve.event_time < COALESCE(pl.leg_end_postime, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY ve.event_time DESC;

query: 帮我算一下船旗国为利比里亚（LR）的所有船舶的总载重吨是多少。
sql: SELECT SUM(dwt) FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE flag_ctry = 'LR';

query: 想知道系统里载重吨最大的前3艘船的英文名称和MMSI码。
sql: SELECT name_en, mmsi FROM maritime.vessel_reference ORDER BY dwt DESC LIMIT 3;

query: 统计一下各个船级社认证的船舶数量，只保留数量大于10的船级社，并按数量从多到少排个序。
sql: SELECT class_society, COUNT(*) FROM maritime.vessel_reference GROUP BY class_society HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

query: 帮我找一下2018年之后建造的、且船长超过250米的船，显示它们的中文名和IMO号。
sql: SELECT name_cn, imo FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE build_year > '2018' AND length > 250;

query: 帮我统计一下集团自有的船舶中，各个船旗国分别有多少艘，列出数量最多的前5个国家。
sql: SELECT flag_ctry, COUNT(*) AS vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE calibre = 1 GROUP BY flag_ctry ORDER BY vessel_count DESC LIMIT 5;

query: 想知道目前标准箱位数最多的前10艘船叫什么名字，分别能装多少个标准箱？
sql: SELECT name_cn, teu FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE teu > 0 ORDER BY teu DESC LIMIT 10;

query: 算一下经营主体名称里带有“海岳航运”的所有船只，它们的平均载重吨是多少，以及总吨位加起来一共是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(dwt) AS avg_dwt, SUM(grt) AS total_grt FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE operator_body_cn LIKE '%海岳航运%';

query: 列出海区编号、中文名和地图层级。
sql: SELECT mrgid_sea, name_cn, map_level FROM maritime.sea_area_reference WHERE mrgid_sea IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mrgid_sea;

query: 帮我统计一下海岳特种运输股份有限公司旗下各个船籍港分别有多少艘船，按数量从多到少排个序。
sql: SELECT registry_port, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE operator_body_cn LIKE '%海岳特种运输股份有限公司%' GROUP BY registry_port ORDER BY cnt DESC;

query: 我想知道海岳特种运输股份有限公司管理的船舶中，总吨位超过50000的船有哪些类型，每种类型的平均载重吨是多少？
sql: SELECT vessel_type, AVG(dwt) AS avg_dwt FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE operator_body_cn LIKE '%海岳特种运输股份有限公司%' AND grt > 50000 GROUP BY vessel_type;

query: 查一下海岳特种运输股份有限公司的船队里，建造年份在2015年及以后的船，按船舶子类型分类看看各自的最大船长是多少。
sql: SELECT vessel_sub_type, MAX(length) AS max_length FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE operator_body_cn LIKE '%海岳特种运输股份有限公司%' AND build_year >= '2015' GROUP BY vessel_sub_type;

query: 查询时区偏移不小于国家或地区平均值的记录，列出代码、中文名和时区偏移。
sql: SELECT ctry_code, name_cn, tz_offset FROM maritime.country_reference WHERE tz_offset >= (SELECT AVG(tz_offset) FROM maritime.country_reference) ORDER BY tz_offset DESC, ctry_code;

query: 帮我数一下各个船旗国分别有多少艘船，列出数量最多的前5个国家。
sql: SELECT flag_ctry, COUNT(mmsi) AS vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_reference GROUP BY flag_ctry ORDER BY vessel_count DESC LIMIT 5;

query: 想找下2020年及以后建造的、并且载重吨超过5万吨的船，看看它们的中文名和建造年月。
sql: SELECT name_cn, build_year_month FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE build_year_month >= '202001' AND dwt > 50000;

query: 查一下集团自有船舶里，总吨位最大的前三艘是哪些？给我看下它们的MMSI码、英文名和总吨位。
sql: SELECT mmsi, name_en, grt FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE calibre = 1 ORDER BY grt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3;

query: 帮我算一下各个国内经营主体名下船舶的总标准箱位数，只要那些总箱位数超过一万的，而且经营主体名字不能是空的。
sql: SELECT operator_body_cn, SUM(teu) AS total_teu FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE operator_body_cn IS NOT NULL AND operator_body_cn <> '' GROUP BY operator_body_cn HAVING SUM(teu) > 10000;

query: 帮我统计一下中国籍船舶在遭遇恶劣天气等风险事件时，平均浪高和最大风速分别是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(e.wave_val) AS avg_wave_height, MAX(e.wind_val) AS max_wind_speed FROM maritime.vessel_reference v JOIN maritime.vessel_event_log e ON v.mmsi = e.mmsi WHERE v.flag_ctry = 'CN' AND e.event_name_code = 'EVENT_RISK';

query: 想知道在开阔水域发生过会遇事件的船舶中，哪艘船的总吨位最大？请告诉我它的中文船名和MMSI号。
sql: SELECT v.name_cn, v.mmsi, v.grt FROM maritime.vessel_reference v JOIN maritime.vessel_event_log e ON v.mmsi = e.mmsi WHERE e.event_name_code = 'EVENT_ENCOUNTER' ORDER BY v.grt DESC LIMIT 1;

query: 查一下2023年期间，有哪些船长超过200米的船发生过新闻事故事件？请列出它们的中文名和事发海域。
sql: SELECT v.name_cn, e.sea_region_cn FROM maritime.vessel_reference v JOIN maritime.vessel_event_log e ON v.mmsi = e.mmsi WHERE v.length > 200 AND e.event_name_code = 'EVENT_MANUAL' AND e.event_time >= '2023-01-01' AND e.event_time < '2024-01-01';

query: 统计一下各个船旗国发生过气象风险事件的船舶数量，只筛选出至少有3艘船发生过此类事件的国家，并按船舶数量降序排列。
sql: SELECT v.flag_ctry, COUNT(DISTINCT v.mmsi) AS vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_reference v JOIN maritime.vessel_event_log e ON v.mmsi = e.mmsi WHERE e.event_name_code = 'EVENT_RISK' GROUP BY v.flag_ctry HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT v.mmsi) >= 3 ORDER BY vessel_count DESC;

query: 帮我统计一下过去半年里，哪些维修船厂修过的船最多？列出船厂名字和修船的数量，按数量从多到少排，给我看前5个就行。
sql: SELECT repair_shipyard, COUNT(DISTINCT mmsi) AS repaired_vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE is_repaired = 1 AND start_postime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY repair_shipyard ORDER BY repaired_vessel_count DESC LIMIT 5;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 我想了解下最近三个月里，那些既做了维修又是满载状态的航段，每艘船（按mmsi区分）的平均航段总时长分别是多少？
sql: SELECT mmsi, AVG(leg_duration_total) AS avg_leg_duration FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE is_repaired = 1 AND is_full_load = 1 AND start_postime > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY mmsi;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 查一下最近一个月里，靠泊作业时间超过48小时的船，把它们的mmsi、靠泊时长显示出来，顺便看看有没有在哪个船厂维修过，结果按靠泊时间从长到短排一下。
sql: SELECT mmsi, berth_duration, repair_shipyard FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE dynamic_type = '5' AND is_new = 0 AND berth_duration > 48 AND start_postime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month' ORDER BY berth_duration DESC;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 帮我按季度统计一下去年有维修记录的船舶数量，以及这些航段中船舶吃水深度的平均变化量，时间按航段开始时间算。
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', start_postime) AS quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT mmsi) AS repaired_vessel_count, AVG(draught_diff) AS avg_draught_diff FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE is_repaired = 1 AND is_new = 0 AND start_postime >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year') AND start_postime < DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW()) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('quarter', start_postime) ORDER BY quarter;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 帮我统计一下最近半年里，哪些维修船厂修过的船最多？列出船厂名字和修船的数量，只给我看前五名。
sql: SELECT repair_shipyard, COUNT(DISTINCT mmsi) AS repaired_vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE is_repaired = 1 AND start_postime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY repair_shipyard ORDER BY repaired_vessel_count DESC LIMIT 5;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 想知道最近三个月里，有哪些船出现过两次以上AIS信号异常并且平均航速不到5节的情况？请列出这些船的mmsi和具体次数。
sql: SELECT mmsi, COUNT(*) AS abnormal_slow_count FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE dynamic_type = '5' AND is_ais_abnormal = 1 AND average_speed < 5 AND start_postime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY mmsi HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 帮我查一下今年以来，船舶的各种动态类型分别产生了多少条记录？
sql: SELECT dynamic_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE start_postime >= DATE_TRUNC('year', NOW()) GROUP BY dynamic_type;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 统计下过去一年内，有哪些满载的船进行过中途锚泊，并且累计中途锚泊时间超过了48小时？请显示它们的mmsi和总中途锚泊时长。
sql: SELECT mmsi, SUM(moor_duration_halfway) AS total_halfway_moor_duration FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE dynamic_type = '5' AND is_full_load = 1 AND moor_times_halfway > 0 AND start_postime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY mmsi HAVING SUM(moor_duration_halfway) > 48;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 帮我统计一下各个船旗国发生过搁浅事故的船只数量，按数量从多到少排个序。
sql: SELECT fv.flag_ctry, COUNT(DISTINCT vd.mmsi) AS grounding_vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_state_history vd JOIN maritime.vessel_reference fv ON vd.mmsi = fv.mmsi WHERE vd.dynamic_type = '6' GROUP BY fv.flag_ctry ORDER BY grounding_vessel_count DESC;

query: 想知道2020年及以后建造的新船，在哪些维修船厂维修时的平均航段总时长最长？帮我列出前5名。
sql: SELECT vd.repair_shipyard, AVG(vd.leg_duration_total) AS avg_leg_duration FROM maritime.vessel_state_history vd JOIN maritime.vessel_reference fv ON vd.mmsi = fv.mmsi WHERE fv.build_year >= '2020' AND vd.is_repaired = 1 AND vd.repair_shipyard IS NOT NULL GROUP BY vd.repair_shipyard ORDER BY avg_leg_duration DESC LIMIT 5;

query: 能不能按船舶的二级分类统计一下，它们在靠泊作业阶段的总航行里程和平均航速分别是多少？
sql: SELECT fv.vessel_sub_type, SUM(vd.leg_sail_distance) AS total_sail_distance, AVG(vd.average_speed) AS avg_speed FROM maritime.vessel_state_history vd JOIN maritime.vessel_reference fv ON vd.mmsi = fv.mmsi WHERE vd.dynamic_type = '5' GROUP BY fv.vessel_sub_type;

query: 查一下中国籍的船里，有哪些船在航段中既发生了中途锚泊又出现了AIS信号异常？帮我统计下每艘船的中文名、异常航段数量以及最长的AIS信号丢失时间。
sql: SELECT fv.name_cn, COUNT(vd.uuid) AS abnormal_leg_count, MAX(vd.max_lost_duration) AS max_lost_hours FROM maritime.vessel_state_history vd JOIN maritime.vessel_reference fv ON vd.mmsi = fv.mmsi WHERE fv.flag_ctry = 'CN' AND vd.dynamic_type = '5' AND vd.moor_times_halfway > 0 AND vd.is_ais_abnormal = 1 GROUP BY fv.name_cn;

query: 帮我统计一下在名字里带“舟山”的船厂维修过的船舶一共有多少艘，以及总共维修了多少次？
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mmsi) AS vessel_count, COUNT(*) AS repair_count FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE is_repaired = 1 AND repair_shipyard LIKE '%舟山%';

query: 想知道MMSI为990000001的船，它各种动态类型（比如航行、锚泊等）的平均每次持续时间分别是多少小时？只统计已经结束的状态。
sql: SELECT dynamic_type, AVG(seg_duration) AS avg_duration_hours FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE mmsi = 990000001 AND is_new = 0 GROUP BY dynamic_type;

query: 查一下2023年5月份开始的航段里，AIS信号出现异常的有多少个，这些异常航段的最大信号丢失时长平均是多少小时？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS abnormal_leg_count, AVG(max_lost_duration) AS avg_max_lost_hours FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE leg_start_year_month = '202305' AND is_ais_abnormal = 1 AND dynamic_type = '5';

query: 帮我按目的港统计一下，那些满载并且直接靠泊的航段，每个目的港的靠泊次数和平均靠泊时长是多少？结果按靠泊次数从多到少排个序。
sql: SELECT leg_end_port_code, COUNT(*) AS direct_moor_count, AVG(berth_duration) AS avg_berth_hours FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE is_full_load = 1 AND is_direct = 1 AND dynamic_type = '5' AND is_new = 0 GROUP BY leg_end_port_code ORDER BY direct_moor_count DESC;

query: 帮我统计下各个船旗国下，设计航速大于20节且船长超过200米的船舶数量，并按数量从多到少排个序。
sql: SELECT flag_ctry, COUNT(mmsi) AS vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE speed > 20 AND length > 200 GROUP BY flag_ctry ORDER BY vessel_count DESC;

query: 我想知道2020年及以后建造，并且载重吨大于5万吨的船里，总吨位最大的前10艘是哪些，列出它们的中文名、IMO号和总吨位。
sql: SELECT name_cn, imo, grt FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE build_year >= '2020' AND dwt > 50000 ORDER BY grt DESC LIMIT 10;

query: 查一下集团自有船舶的平均设计吃水深度是多少，顺便算一下这批船的最大和最小船长。
sql: SELECT AVG(draught) AS avg_draught, MAX(length) AS max_length, MIN(length) AS min_length FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE calibre = 1;

query: 帮我找一下气体舱容量大于5万立方米，而且船宽超过30米的船，显示它们的MMSI、中文名、船宽和气体舱容量，按气体舱容量从大到小排。
sql: SELECT mmsi, name_cn, width, gas FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE gas > 50000 AND width > 30 ORDER BY gas DESC;

query: 帮我查下最近5年内建造的船里，总吨位排前10的船舶中文名和mmsi分别是多少？
sql: SELECT name_cn, mmsi FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, TO_DATE(build_year, 'YYYY'))) <= 5 ORDER BY grt DESC LIMIT 10;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 统计下各个船旗国名下注册的船有多少艘，结果按数量从多到少排个序给我看看。
sql: SELECT flag_ctry, count(mmsi) FROM maritime.vessel_reference GROUP BY flag_ctry ORDER BY count(mmsi) DESC;

query: 列出海事公告的类型、标题和发布时间。
sql: SELECT notice_type, notice_title, notice_time FROM maritime.regulatory_notice WHERE notice_title IS NOT NULL ORDER BY notice_time DESC;

query: 查一下中国籍的船里面，船长大于200米并且船宽大于30米的，它们的平均设计航速是多少节？
sql: SELECT avg(speed) FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE flag_ctry = 'CN' AND length > 200 AND width > 30;

query: 帮我查一下集团租赁的船舶中，各个船旗国分别有多少艘船，按数量从多到少排个序。
sql: SELECT flag_ctry, COUNT(mmsi) AS vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE calibre = 2 GROUP BY flag_ctry ORDER BY vessel_count DESC;

query: 统计一下集团自有船舶中，各个建造年份的船只数量和平均载重吨，只看2015年及以后建造的。
sql: SELECT build_year, COUNT(*) AS cnt, AVG(dwt) AS avg_dwt FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE calibre = 1 AND build_year >= '2015' GROUP BY build_year ORDER BY build_year;

query: 按方向统计有效航行节点数量，只列出节点数不少于该方向平均节点数的方向。
sql: WITH direction_counts AS (SELECT direction, COUNT(*) AS node_count FROM maritime.route_node_reference WHERE COALESCE(is_void, 0) = 0 GROUP BY direction) SELECT direction, node_count FROM direction_counts WHERE node_count >= (SELECT AVG(node_count) FROM direction_counts) ORDER BY node_count DESC, direction;

query: 统计集团自有船舶中，各个所属船队拥有多少艘船长超过200米的船，只列出数量大于5的船队。
sql: SELECT fleet_body, COUNT(mmsi) AS ship_count FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE calibre = 1 AND length > 200 GROUP BY fleet_body HAVING COUNT(mmsi) > 5;

query: 帮我统计一下最近30天内，各个船旗国的船在鹿特丹港（NLRTM）靠泊的总次数，按次数从高到低排个前五名。
sql: SELECT v.flag_ctry, COUNT(d.uuid) AS moor_count FROM maritime.vessel_reference v JOIN maritime.vessel_state_history d ON v.mmsi = d.mmsi WHERE d.dynamic_type = '5' AND d.is_new = 0 AND d.leg_end_port_code = 'NLRTM' AND d.start_postime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY v.flag_ctry ORDER BY moor_count DESC LIMIT 5;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 查询开始日期不晚于所有特殊区域最晚开始日期的区域代码、中文名和开始日期。
sql: SELECT region_code, name_cn, start_date FROM maritime.special_region_reference WHERE start_date <= (SELECT MAX(start_date) FROM maritime.special_region_reference) ORDER BY start_date DESC NULLS LAST;

query: 查一下昨天在航行途中出现过AIS信号异常的船，把它们的MMSI码、英文名和所属船队列出来，记得去重。
sql: SELECT DISTINCT v.mmsi, v.name_en, v.fleet_body FROM maritime.vessel_reference v JOIN maritime.vessel_state_history d ON v.mmsi = d.mmsi WHERE d.is_ais_abnormal = 1 AND d.dynamic_type = '0' AND d.start_postime >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' AND d.start_postime < CURRENT_DATE;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 帮我统计下过去半年里，每个月在新加坡港（SGSGP）卸货的船舶数量，按月份展示。
sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(d.start_postime, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT d.mmsi) AS vessel_count FROM maritime.vessel_state_history d JOIN maritime.vessel_reference v ON d.mmsi = v.mmsi WHERE d.dynamic_type = '5' AND d.is_new = 0 AND d.leg_end_port_code = 'SGSGP' AND d.load_type = 0 AND d.start_postime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(d.start_postime, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month;
difficulty_reasons: 包含时间函数或时间窗口

query: 帮我查一下IMO是9000041的船，在它所有的历史航段里，哪一次航行的总里程最远？把那次航段的开始时间、结束时间和平均航速告诉我。
sql: SELECT leg_start_postime, leg_end_postime, average_speed FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE mmsi = (SELECT mmsi FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE imo = '9000041') AND dynamic_type = '5' AND is_new = 0 ORDER BY leg_sail_distance DESC LIMIT 1;

query: 我想统计一下，管理公司是“海岳航运”的船队，在2023年10月份一共完成了多少个航段？这些航段的总航行里程加起来是多少？
sql: SELECT COUNT(d.uuid) AS leg_count, SUM(d.leg_sail_distance) AS total_distance FROM maritime.vessel_state_history d JOIN maritime.vessel_reference v ON d.mmsi = v.mmsi WHERE v.manage_body_cn = '海岳航运' AND d.leg_start_year_month = '202310' AND d.dynamic_type = '5' AND d.is_new = 0;

query: 中文名叫“海岳荷花”的船最近一次靠泊作业时，吃水深度变化了多少？另外这次航段里它一共锚泊了多少次，锚泊总时长是多久？
sql: SELECT draught_diff, moor_times_total, moor_duration_total FROM maritime.vessel_state_history WHERE mmsi = (SELECT mmsi FROM maritime.vessel_reference WHERE name_cn = '海岳荷花') AND dynamic_type = '5' AND is_new = 0 ORDER BY start_postime DESC LIMIT 1;

query: 帮我看看IMO为9000065的船舶，在它满载的那些航段里，都是从哪个港口出发到哪个港口去的？每次满载航段总共花了多少小时？

query: 帮我统计一下2024年10月份，所有基本港的平均在港船舶总载重吨是多少，并按载重吨从高到低排个序，顺便带上港口中文名。
sql:
SELECT p.name_cn, AVG(e.stay_dwt) AS avg_stay_dwt
FROM maritime.port_reference p
JOIN maritime.port_efficiency_snapshot e ON p.port_code = e.port_code
WHERE p.port_type = 'B' AND e.year_month = '2024-10'
GROUP BY p.name_cn
ORDER BY avg_stay_dwt DESC;
